description: Found by the cold audit of bedrock-jb4 (PR #253). handle_empty_page/4 does not add the emptied page to modified_page_ids, and Index.delete_pages/2 rewrites a predecessor's next_id without marking that predecessor modified. Pre-existing and currently masked because compaction persists the whole page map; if page persistence ever becomes incremental (only modified_page_ids written), an eviction would drop the next_id rewrite and the chain would skip or dangle. Reproduce with a test that clears a range emptying a middle page, then asserts the predecessor whose next_id changed is in modified_page_ids.
title: Olivine: handle_empty_page/4 and Index.delete_pages/2 mutate pages without marking them modified
